# Anthony Baptiste

> Motivational speaker, certified paralegal and transformational coach in Queens, New York. Sentenced to 51 years to life as a first-time, non-violent offender, he learned the law while incarcerated, proved his sentence was illegal and won his release on his own motion in February 2026. He speaks on resilience, transformation and second chances.

## Topics
- Wrongful Conviction and Justice
- Resilience After Incarceration
- Self-Advocacy and Personal Transformation
- Second Chances, Purpose and Reinvention

## Audiences
Schools, colleges and universities, youth programs, nonprofits, conferences, corporate events, justice reform panels, podcasts and media.

## Fees
- Schools, youth programs and nonprofits: beginner rate, negotiable per event
- Universities and conferences: starting at $2,000, to discuss
- Corporate events: on request
